summary: Executed backend + frontend verification for Walk-ins CRM Phase 4 using the public preview URL. Backend duplicate-rule checks passed after transient gateway instability handling; required foundation suite passed 15/15. Responsive UI checks (desktop/tablet/phone) found no horizontal overflow but uncovered medium-duplicate resolution UX/integration issues and phone sheet accessibility concerns.

minor.issue: Intermittent 502 Bad Gateway from Cloudflare host during first test run caused setup errors; retry with HTTP retry adapter stabilized subsequent runs.
Pytest emits `PytestConfigWarning: Unknown config option: asyncio_mode` during runs (test hygiene/config drift).
Test hygiene issue: hardcoded fallback BASE_URL and hardcoded owner credentials in test file instead of strict env-only config.

ui_bugs.issue: `View Customer` action did not navigate away from /walkins/new in browser run where action button was present and clicked.
`Use Existing Customer` flow did not complete a new walk-in transition in UI runs; page remained on /walkins/new after attempts (expected redirect to /walkins/[id]).
Bottom sheet content is visually constrained/overlapped by bottom navigation/FAB region; picker options were not reliably interactable in phone check.

integration_issues.issue: Routes loaded, but console log captured repeated request aborts (`net::ERR_ABORTED`) on several API calls while rapidly switching pages; requires validation under normal user pacing.
Observed burst of 401 API responses before re-login recovery in one retest run.

issues: Assign Salesperson sheet appears cramped by persistent bottom bar/FAB area, reducing accessibility of lower sheet controls.

react_native_issues.issue: Console repeatedly logs deprecated style/runtime warnings (`shadow*` -> `boxShadow`, `props.pointerEvents` deprecated, `useNativeDriver` fallback).

action_items: Fix medium-duplicate sheet actions: ensure `View Customer` reliably navigates and `Use Existing Customer` reliably completes linked walk-in creation.
Review phone bottom-sheet layering/z-index/padding so Assign Salesperson sheet controls are fully accessible above the bottom nav/FAB.
Stabilize preview host/API path against intermittent 502 and noisy aborted requests to reduce flaky E2E behavior.
Clean test hygiene in `test_walkins_crm_foundation.py` (remove hardcoded fallback URL and credentials).
critical_code_review_comments: `backend/tests/integration/test_walkins_crm_foundation.py` violates strict env-only testing policy by including fallback URL and embedded credentials.
Walk-ins duplicate detection backend behavior for name+city, name+address, high phone reuse, and email force-new conflict is now functionally correct (verified by dedicated pytest).
Frontend duplicate-resolution sheet is likely functionally brittle under real interaction timing despite backend correctness; UI state handling around resolution selection should be reviewed.

success_rate.backend: 19/19 targeted tests passed (4/4 duplicate-rules + 15/15 foundation) after retry stabilization
success_rate.frontend: Core route loading/responsive checks passed; duplicate-resolution and phone sheet interaction issues remain (partial pass)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed Walk-in records during verification (e.g., TEST_UI_1785454565, TEST_RET_1785454639, TEST_PROBE_*), including duplicate-attempt records for medium/high match validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Known created walk-in from primary UI run: cafe2fa5-49a5-4013-a9fa-56ca44432384. Backend endpoints are currently healthy and foundation suite passes. Re-test specifically the medium-duplicate modal actions and phone sheet accessibility after fixes, then rerun the two pytest files listed above.
rca_of_issue: UI-side duplicate-resolution flow appears inconsistent: backend correctly returns 409 with resolvable matches, but frontend action handling in the medium-match sheet did not consistently complete expected transitions in automation runs. Reproduction: create seed walk-in, attempt second walk-in with same name+city and different phone, open resolution sheet, use `View Customer` / `Use Existing Customer`; observed no reliable navigation/create completion. Potential mitigation: verify button testID forwarding in shared Button component and confirm resolvedCustomerId state persists through submit path.
